description: This Ruby script automates building and updating documentation for Apache Spark, including Scala, Java, Python, R, and SQL API docs, as well as error documentation. It includes functions for building, copying, and updating documentation files, and manages dependencies and build steps.

methods.name: print_header
methods.description: Prints a formatted header banner with the given text.

methods.name: build_spark_if_necessary
methods.description: Builds Spark if it has not been built on the host, using sbt.

methods.name: copy_and_update_scala_docs
methods.description: Copies Scala documentation and appends custom JS and CSS.

methods.name: copy_and_update_java_docs
methods.description: Copies Java documentation, updates JavaDoc HTML files with script references, and appends CSS.

methods.name: build_spark_scala_and_java_docs_if_necessary
methods.description: Generates Scala and Java API documentation if not already built.

methods.name: build_scala_and_java_docs
methods.description: Builds Spark, then generates Scala and Java API docs, copying and updating files.
